events.speaker: caller
events.text: Hello sir, I'm attorney Paul Winters representing your grandson.

events.speaker: caller
events.text: There's been a collision with a pregnant woman. He's facing charges, and he's asked me to reach you.

events.speaker: caller
events.text: A retainer of 9,500 will get him out. You can pay by wire or send cash in a box to my associate.

events.speaker: customer
events.text: I'd like to talk to him.

events.speaker: caller
events.text: He can't speak. There's a gag order on this, so you must keep it secret.
